issues.description: Missing input validation on user-provided todo text allowing potential NoSQL injection
issues.suggestion: Add validation: const sanitized = String(text).trim(); if (!sanitized) throw new Error("Invalid text");

issues.description: Race condition in concurrent todo updates - no transaction or locking mechanism
issues.suggestion: Implement optimistic locking with version field or use database transactions

issues.description: N+1 query pattern when fetching todos with associated data
issues.suggestion: Use database joins or batch loading instead of sequential queries

issues.description: Missing error handling for database connection failures
issues.suggestion: Add try-catch blocks and proper error propagation to caller

codeQuality.summary: Critical security and concurrency issues found in database operations requiring immediate attention

untestedPaths.reasoning: Database error scenarios never tested but affect data integrity
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: Mock database failures and verify error handling behavior
Simulate parallel updates and verify consistency

testCoverage.summary: Insufficient test coverage for critical error handling and concurrent operations

suggestions.description: Extract validation logic into dedicated validation service
suggestions.benefits: Reusable validation, easier testing, centralized business rules

suggestions.description: Implement repository pattern for database access
suggestions.benefits: Better abstraction, easier mocking, cleaner separation of concerns

refactorings.summary: Multiple refactoring opportunities to improve maintainability and testability

recommendations.description: Implement comprehensive input validation for all user-provided data
Add concurrency control mechanisms to prevent race conditions
Add integration tests for database error scenarios
